3.5 Functional Requirements 
Table 6 Functional Requirements 
ID Priority Requirement Details and achieved outcome 
F1 MUST Short video 
content delivery 
Deliver and stream short videos form 
videos with a length of around 30 
seconds, aligning with modern platforms 
such as TikTok (Zaveri, 2023). This 
concise format should ensure videos are 
digestible for the modern student. 
 
Outcome: Increased student attention 
and engagement. 
F2 MUST Interactive 
questions 
Interactive questions are displayed after 
each video at the lesson designer’s 
discretion. These questions should be 
designed with higher order thinking in 
mind and should take on the high-level 
question format as previously highlighted 
in chapter two (Richmond & Hagan, 
2011). These questions will directly 
assess and reinforce the student on the 
delivered content, leveraging the students 
improved attention span.
